_note: Synthetic recorded responses used for offline tests. These are test fixtures, not captured model outputs. Replace with deliberately recorded API responses only after a real model call is performed and reviewed.
_model_target: claude-opus-5 (the shape these are written against; no response from it has been captured)

higher_uplift.rationale: This cell shows 1180/4000 recovered treated against 640/4000 holdout, an uplift of 1350 bps with an interval of [900, 1800] that excludes zero and sits entirely above the population effect of 1564 bps at its upper end.

lower_uplift.rationale: Recovery in the treated arm barely exceeds the holdout arm here, and the interval [200, 800] excludes zero while sitting well below the population effect.

no_effect.rationale: Treated and holdout recovery rates are close and the interval [-300, 400] spans zero, so this cell looks indistinguishable from no effect.

coarse_level.rationale: Aggregated across payment methods the insufficient-funds cell retains a positive interval that excludes zero.

invented_cell_key.rationale: A cell the model invented. It appears in no population and must be refused.

wrong_ladder_level.rationale: Names a real fine-level cell but asserts the wrong rung.

invented_evidence.rationale: Cites a comparison cell that was never supplied.
